bundle.shortDescription: Signarm Signal — API platform to build, test, mock, and document APIs.
bundle.longDescription: Signarm Signal is a local-first API platform for designing, testing, mocking, and documenting HTTP APIs. All your collections, environments, and history stay on your machine.
